label: Hemisphere
depicts: Side hemisphere shell with one vertical inner curve centered inside the form
use_when: Use when the interface wants a vertical half sphere seen from the side with one inner dividing curve.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bowl hemisphere when the opening rim should lie across the top.

label: Hexagons
depicts: Three separate hexagon shapes with one top cell above two lower cells
use_when: Use when the interface wants three detached hexagon cells arranged in a triangle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the joined hexagon cluster when the cells should share borders.

label: Hexagons
depicts: Three joined hexagon shapes with one top cell touching two lower cells
use_when: Use when the interface wants a honeycomb style cluster where the hexagons share borders.
avoid_when: Do not use for the separated hexagon cells when visible gaps should remain between the shapes.

label: History
depicts: Clock ring with one curved outer arrow and one centered hand inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants history shown as a clock face with one outer return arrow.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rewind clock when the arrow should sit at the upper left and the inner ticks should show.

label: History
depicts: Open clock ring with one upper left arrow and three inner tick marks
use_when: Use when the interface wants history shown as an open clock ring with a top left arrow.
avoid_when: Do not use for the closed history clock when a centered hand should appear inside the ring.
